# 12 · Autonomous flight & mission planning

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

Missions as lists of waypoints, planning them in a ground station, the geofence and RTL logic that contain them, automatic takeoff and precision landing, and writing your own mission logic in Python.
